title: 第2333章 姜玄烨败第2332章 金刚伏魔印
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: “姜玄烨”的脸色苍白如纸，嘴角已经溢出了鲜血。
体内的禁制已经开始反噬，让他痛苦不堪，而他现在还与白帝比拼的关键中，还不能分心镇压禁制。
“为师倒是小看你了。”
“姜玄烨”缓缓开口，异常的冷静：“还有什么招数一起使出来，为师奉陪就是。”
白帝神色一冷，他知道“姜玄烨”在硬撑。
他专门用来对付这老怪物的禁制，一旦无法镇压，就会在体内四处作妖。
即便今天杀不了他，他刚刚占据的这具身体，也会经脉受损，迫使他从这具身体里逃出来。
“既然如此，我还有一招！”
白帝的声音变得格外的凝重。
随后刺出了一剑。
没有任何的声音。
没有任何的光芒。
天地间仿佛在这一刻失去了所有的色彩，就连“姜玄烨”的剑都失去了踪影。
那些围观的武修都愣住了。
他们修为皆都不弱，居然看不到这一剑。
“他手中的剑呢？”
“老夫眼花了吗？他手中的剑消失了？”
他们只看到了白帝伫立在虚空之中，还在原地，但是他手中的那柄剑不见了。
这诡异的一幕，顿时就让所有人皆都心头一惊。
“不是看不到，而是这一剑的速度太快了，已经超越了我们能感知的层次。”
有武圣强者唏嘘道。
“他们这一战，你们说谁会赢？”
纵横城城主突然开口问道。
他身后的一众手下对望了一眼。
从实力来看，如果“姜玄烨”不是体内禁制的原因，哪怕被封印了这么多年，也能吊打白帝，但是偏偏被白帝给阴了，导致他现在完全发挥不出强大的实力。
从刚才两人的交手看出，白帝已经能稳压“姜玄烨”了。
“城主，应该是白帝胜吧。”
一个老者小声道。
“你说了？”
城主看向了另外一个长老。
那长老微微一笑：“此人之前是武神，必然有通天的手段，或许现在是白帝占了上风，但是不到最后，胜负还难说。”
城主微微点头，显然他也是认可此长老的话，这就让刚才说话的那个老者有些尴尬了。
不过，他也是厚脸皮，装作没事人，权当自己刚才说的话就是放屁。
城主眼睛微眯，以他的实力，自然是看到了那一剑。
即使是他，也是心惊不已。
因为这一剑，无声无息，却比之前任何气势浩大的剑招都要恐怖数倍。
到了他这等境界，他非常的清楚，有的时候，气势浩大的剑招威力不一定比无声无息的一剑要来的恐怖。
甚至，看不到的，远远比看到的更加让人感觉恐惧。
“姜玄烨”的瞳孔骤然一缩，他感受到了死亡的气息。
此时的他，居然感受到了死亡的气息，这是多么不可思议的事情。
content_en:
"Jiang Xuanye's" face was as pale as paper, and blood was already spilling from the corners of his mouth.
The restrictions in his body had begun to bite back, causing him unbearable pain, and he was still at the critical point of competing with Bai Di, so he couldn't distract himself from suppressing the restrictions.
"I underestimate you as a teacher."
"Jiang Xuanye" spoke slowly, unusually calmly: "Use any other tricks together, just to accompany the master."
Bai Di's expression turned cold. He knew that "Jiang Xuanye" was holding on.
The restraint he specially used to deal with this old monster will cause monsters everywhere in his body once it cannot be suppressed.
Even if he can't be killed today, the body he just occupied will have its meridians damaged, forcing him to escape from this body.
"In that case, I have another trick!"
Bai Di's voice became particularly solemn.
Then he thrust out a sword.
There is no sound.
There is no light.
The world seemed to have lost all color at this moment, and even "Jiang Xuanye's" sword had disappeared.
The martial arts cultivators who were watching were stunned.
Their cultivation levels are not weak, but they can't even see this sword.
"Where's the sword in his hand?"
"Is this old man dazzled? The sword in his hand disappeared?"
They only saw Bai Emperor standing in the void, still in place, but the sword in his hand was missing.
This strange scene immediately shocked everyone.
"It's not that we can't see it, but the speed of this sword is too fast, and it has surpassed the level we can perceive."
A strong Martial Saint sighed.
Everyone: "..."
"Who do you think will win in this fight between them?"
The Lord of Zongheng City suddenly asked.
"This..."
The men behind him looked at each other.
From the perspective of strength, if "Jiang Xuanye" was not the cause of the restriction in the body, he could still defeat Bai Emperor even after being sealed for so many years. However, Bai Emperor happened to trick him, causing him to be unable to display his strong strength at all.
From the fight between the two just now, it can be seen that Bai Di has been able to stabilize "Jiang Xuanye".
"City Lord, it should be Bai Di Sheng."
An old man whispered.
"You said that?"
The city lord looked at the other elder.
The elder smiled slightly: "This man was a god of war before, so he must have extraordinary means. Maybe Bai Di has the upper hand now, but until the end, it's hard to say whether he will win or lose."
The city lord nodded slightly, obviously he also recognized the elder's words, which made the old man who just spoke a little embarrassed.
However, he was also shameless and pretended to be fine, thinking that what he just said was just fart.
The city lord narrowed his eyes slightly. With his strength, he naturally saw the sword.
Even he was frightened.
Because this sword was silent, but it was several times more terrifying than any previous powerful sword moves.
At his level, he knew very well that sometimes, a powerful sword move might not be as terrifying as a silent sword move.
Even what you can't see is far more frightening than what you see.
"Jiang Xuanye's" pupils suddenly shrank, and he felt the breath of death.
At this moment, he actually felt the breath of death. What an incredible thing.
